reports.notes: Handwritten summary page. The filer writes cents as a raised superscript with no decimal point (e.g. Box A is '4,773' with a superscript '67'); those are rendered here with a decimal point, which is a transcription of the filer's own cents notation, not a computed value. Boxes B and C carry NO cents at all as written ('32,970' and '6,820'). Box D is written with an odd internal space and no comma ('11 221' + superscript '44') - transcribed '11,221.44' at medium confidence. Box E is written without a comma ('7370' + superscript '67') and is kept that way. FILER INCONSISTENCIES, retained verbatim and NOT corrected: Box C (Contributions Year to Date, 6,820) is SMALLER than Box B (this period, 32,970), and Box E (Expenditures YTD, 7370.67) is smaller than Box D (this period, 11,221.44) - the year-to-date pair appears to have been filled in wrongly by the filer. Address block and signature are blacked out (redacted upstream by the county). Office is handwritten as 'Commission Seat B' - no 'Utah County' prefix on the page, though it agrees with the index.

notes: PAGINATION MISMATCH worth flagging: the PDF is 16 physical pages, but the form's own page boxes read 'Page 1 of 7' on the cover (physical p1) and 'Page 2 of 7' on the summary (physical p13) - the county's scan interleaves ~11 other physical pages between the cover and the summary of what the filer numbered as a 7-page report. contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 32,970 on the p13 Summary Page, which is also the printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' = 32,970 written at the foot of PDF p3 (the filer's own sheet 'Page 4 of 7')
contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets. PDF p5 (filer's sheet 3 of 7) holds 2 rows: 200.00 + 20.00 = 220.00 against its printed 'Subtotal for this page'; that subtotal cell is an OVERWRITTEN glyph (a middle digit written over another, legible by eye as either 220 or 280) and the page's own arithmetic settles it at 220 — see notes, nothing was nudged. PDF p3 (filer's sheet 4 of 7) holds 15 rows summing 1000+1000+500+2500+500+1000+2500+5000+10000+2000+150+5000+500+100+1000 = 32,750.00 exactly = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $32,750' (crop-proved). 32,750.00 + 220.00 = 32,970.00 = the printed 'Total Contributions Received' on p3 AND the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B (32,970). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 6,820 and is NOT summed as an increment — on this cover the CUMULATIVE figure is SMALLER than the per-period figure, which is the filer's own inconsistency and is documented/adjudicated by the coordinator: the page's own identity ratifies Box B, since Box F = A + B = 4,773.67 + 32,970 = 37,743.67 exactly as printed and close = F - D = 26,522.23 exactly as printed. Box C was not 'fixed' and the C < B relation was not treated as an error. IN-KIND: monetary-only gives 30,820.00 and FAILS; monetary-plus-in-kind (the 2,000.00 Wasatch Wing & Clay and 150.00 Chubby's rows, each written '<amount> In Kind' in the amount cell) gives 32,970.00 and CLOSES.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 11,221.44 on the p13 Summary Page, which is also the printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' = 11,221.44 written at the foot of PDF p9 (the filer's own sheet 'Page 7 of 7')
expenditures.detail: THREE Schedule B sheets. PDF p7 (sheet 5 of 7) 15 rows: 140.79+14.61+159.44+16.73+500.00+200.00+149.87+18.70+20.49+480.14+173.87+18.58+498.76+63.28+2000.00 = 4,455.26 exactly = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $4,455.26' (crop-proved). PDF p11 (sheet 6 of 7) 1 row: 150.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $150'. PDF p9 (sheet 7 of 7) 15 rows: 500.00+359.82+22.00+118.29+690.34+95.00+329.44+63.28+900.00+83.34+2891.46+22.16+357.64+73.50+109.91 = 6,616.18 exactly = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $6,616.18' (crop-proved). 4,455.26 + 150.00 + 6,616.18 = 11,221.44 = the printed grand total AND the promoted per-period Box D. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 7370.67 and is never summed as an increment. IN-KIND: monetary-only gives 9,071.44 and FAILS; monetary-plus-in-kind (2,000.00 on p7 row 15 and 150.00 on p11 row 1, both written '<amount> In Kind') gives 11,221.44 and CLOSES.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on BOTH sides, tested per filing (never inherited). Two gifts are entered TWICE — once as a contribution and once as an offsetting expenditure of the identical amount and date (Wasatch Wing & Clay 2,000.00 dated 10/23/21; Chubby's / Chubby's Cafe 150.00 dated 10/23/21) — the §G1/§K4 double-entry pattern. Both stated totals (Box B 32,970 and Box D 11,221.44) include them; monetary-only fails by 2,150.00 on EACH side.
